description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter as a copy of Galadriel.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters, Galadriel triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Galadriel.
When Galadriel enters, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
